Information Collection and Use
Siyavula and/or its authorised technology agents collect certain Personal Information from You in connection with Your use of the Website and/or the products and/services provided to You by Siyavula.

We use the term “Usage Data” to refer to this information about Your use of the Website that We collect. Siyavula’s purpose in collecting Usage Data is to better understand how You use the Website, so that We can improve Our services.
Cookies are small files sent from a Website to a User's computer drive that can be used to track when a User visits and re-visits a Website and how they behave on a Website.
